title: M2.1: External identities, trust classes and member linking
description:
Add external_identity items and the trust class resolution member, guest, unknown, blocked (contract section 4). Implement email linking: a member's verified sign-in address links automatically on first authenticated inbound; extra addresses are added in the web app and confirmed by a one-time emailed link. Removal and demotion take effect at the next message. Unknown goes to quarantine (M2.3); member turns start with the conversational grant.

Acceptance criteria:
- A message from an address that matches no member and no admission is classified unknown and starts no turn
- A removed member's next message is not treated as a member
- A member cannot link another member's address; confirmation links are single use and expire
- Trust class is recorded on the message origin and visible to the owner

Gherkin: features/external_sender_trust.feature

Depends on: M1.8

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
